blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Creating a dialogue scene typically requires cutting between multiple views (e.g., close-ups, medium shots, and over-the-shoulder shots) of the actors. Yet capturing such coverage is costly and in many settings unavailable. We study dialogue re-cinematography: synthesizing additional shots from a single wide-angle dialogue video. Existing video generators can synthesize new shots, but rely on visual cues alone, so when the source video barely shows the lips, the generated lip motion fails to match the speech. Our key observation is that the speech audio is view-invariant: it constrains lip motion in any target view. Building on this insight, we adapt a pretrained audio-visual diffusion model to generate the new shot from a target frame that specifies the view, a source video that contains the performance, and the speech audio that drives lip motion. In multi-person scenes, however, pretrained audio-visual models drive every visible face with the same speech, causing speech leakage, where silent listeners mouth the speaker's words. We therefore introduce speaker-aware audio gating, a training-free module that lets the audio drive only the faces that speak in the target shot. On a cinematic paired-view benchmark spanning diverse viewpoints and framings, our method lowers perceptual error by 59%, landmark error by 56%, and speech leakage by 97% relative to the strongest baseline, Wan 3.0. Our method also remains robust on in-the-wild scenes, highlighting its potential for film post-production.
blocks.zh: 创建对话场景通常需要剪接演员的多处取景(如特写,中镜头,和肩部过镜头). 然而,在很多情况下,获取这种覆盖面是昂贵的,而且无法做到。 我们研究对话的再焚化图:从一个单一的广角对话视频中合成更多的镜头. 已存在的视频生成器可以合成出新的镜头,但仅依靠视觉提示,因此当源视频勉强显示出唇相时,所生成的唇动未能与语音相匹配. 我们的关键观察是,语音音频是视图-变量的:它限制任何目标视图的唇动. 在这个洞察力的基础上,我们改用一个经过预先训练的视听传播模型,从一个指定了视图的目标框,一个包含性能的源视频,以及驱动口语运动的语音音频生成出新镜头. 然而在多人场景中,经过预先训练的视听模型会用同名的演讲来驱动每一个能见度的面相,导致语音渗出,默默地听者会说出演讲者的话来. 因此,我们引入了有发言者意识的音频配乐,这是一个无培训模块,只允许音频驱动目标镜头中说话的面孔。 在一个横跨不同观点和框架的影视配对基准上,我们的方法将认知错误降低了59%,标志性错误降低了56%,与最强基线Wan 3.0相比,语音泄漏下降了97%。 我们的方法在全局的场景上也依然有力,突出了其电影后期制作的潜力.

blocks.en: Films often carry their story through conversation, and the dramatic force of a dialogue scene depends as much on editing as on performance. An editor can only cut between shots that were filmed, so filmmakers shoot each scene with coverage —capturing a set of shots for the editor to choose from ( Arijon, 1976 ; Murch, 2001 ) . For dialogue, typical coverage includes a wide master shot, close-ups and over-the-shoulder shots of the speaker, and reaction shots of the listeners (Figure 2 ). Capturing these shots requires multiple camera positions, either with several synchronized cameras on a single take or over repeated takes. Both are costly and often infeasible for independent films, documentaries, and interviews. We therefore study dialogue re-cinematography : synthesizing additional shots from a single wide-angle dialogue video as if the take had been filmed with multiple cameras (Figure 1 ).
blocks.zh: 电影经常通过对话来传递故事,对话场景的戏剧性力量取决于编辑和表演. 一个编辑只能剪接被拍摄的镜头之间,因此电影制作人拍摄每个有报道的场景——拍摄一组镜头供编辑选择(Arijon,1976;Murch,2001). 对于对话,典型的报导包括一个宽主镜头,特写和演讲者肩上过肩镜头,以及听众的反应镜头(图2). 捕捉出这些镜头需要多个相机位置,要么在一次拍摄上安装多台同步相机,要么重复拍摄. 对独立电影、纪录片和采访来说,两者都是昂贵的,而且往往不可行。 因此,我们研究对话再焚化图:从一个单一的广角对话视频中合成更多的镜头,仿佛镜头是用多相机拍摄的(图1)。

blocks.en: Conventional re-cinematography methods simulate additional cameras with a crop window that pans, tilts, and zooms within the source video ( Gleicher and Liu, 2008 ; Gandhi et al., 2014 ; Truong and Agrawala, 2019 ; Girmaji et al., 2025 ) . A crop, however, never moves the camera: a close-up only enlarges the source pixels, and an over-the-shoulder shot is impossible when the source video films the actors in profile. In contrast, recent video generation methods can move the camera by conditioning on the source video and a camera trajectory ( Bai et al., 2025b ; Zhang et al., 2025b ; Yu et al., 2025 ; Ren et al., 2025 ; Lin et al., 2026b ; Paliwal et al., 2026 ; Namekata et al., 2026 ) , synthesizing content that the source video never captured. However, when the source video shows an actor in profile, from behind, or too far away for the lips to be read clearly, these models hallucinate lip motions that fail to match the dialogue. Viewers are sensitive to mismatches between lips and speech ( ITU-R, 1998 ; Vatakis and Spence, 2006 ; McGurk and MacDonald, 1976 ) , which makes these models impractical for dialogue re-cinematography.
blocks.zh: 常规再焚化方法模拟更多相机,其收成窗口在源视频中进行平板、倾斜和放大(Gleicher和Liu,2008年;Gandhi等人,2014年;Truong和Agrawala,2019年;Girmaji等人,2025年)。 然而,一粒收成从不移动相机:特写只能放大出源像素,而当源视频拍摄到配置中的演员时,过度肩射是不可能的. 相形之下,最近的视频生成方法可以通过对源视频和相机轨迹的调节来移动相机(Bai等,2025b; Zhang等,2025b;Yu等,2025;Ren等,2025;Lin等,2026b;Paliwal等,2026;Namekata等,2026) ,合成了源视频从未捕捉到的内容. 然而,当源视频显示一个角色在外形上,从后方,或从太远处,无法清晰地读出嘴唇时,这些模型会产生无法与对话相匹配的唇动. 观看者对唇与口语之间的不匹配很敏感(ITU-R,1998;Vatakis and Spence,2006;McGurk and MacDonald,1976.),这使得这些模型对于对话再生制作不切实际.

blocks.en: Our key observation is that the audio can supply information that the pixels may lack. Speech is tightly coupled to lip motion ( Yehia et al., 1998 ; Chandrasekaran et al., 2009 ) and is shared among all possible viewpoints. When an actor says “map,” the lips close on /m/, whether the camera faces the actor or sees only the back of the head. The audio is thus a view-invariant anchor for the lip motion in every new shot.
blocks.zh: 我们的关键观察是,音频可以提供像素可能缺乏的信息. 发言与口头动议紧密相联(Yehia等人,1998年;Chandrasekaran等人,2009年),所有可能的观点都同意。 当一名演员说出"地图"时,嘴唇会紧贴在/m/上,无论是相机面对演员还是只看到后脑勺. 音频因此成为了每个新镜头中唇动的无所适从的锚.

blocks.en: Building on this observation, we adapt a pretrained audio-visual diffusion model ( HaCohen et al., 2026 ) to generate a new shot conditioned on the source video and its speech audio. The source video carries the performance, and the audio grounds the lip motion. Users specify the desired shot by providing its first frame, usually framed as one of the common cinematic shots (Figure 2 ). An off-the-shelf image editing model can produce this frame from the source video’s opening frame and a cinematic prompt, such as “a close-up of the man.” The filmmaker can thus preview several framings as still images and pick one before generation.
blocks.zh: 基于这一观察,我们改用一个经过预先训练的视听传播模型(HaCohen等,2026年)来生成一个以源视频及其语音音频为条件的新镜头. 源相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相 用户通过提供第一帧来指定所希望的镜头,通常被设定为常见的电影镜头之一(图2 . 一个现成的图像编辑模型可以从源视频的开机框和一个电影提示(如“男性的特写 ” ) 产生出这个帧。 因此,制片人可以预览几个框架作为静态图像,并在一代人之前选择一个.

blocks.en:
In multi-person scenes, grounding lip motion in speech has to be handled with care. Specifically, the speech must be bound to the person who utters it. Audio-visual video diffusion models typically inject the audio into every video token through cross-attention, resulting in speech leakage , where silent listeners mouth another participant’s words ( Polaczek et al., 2026a ) .
We therefore introduce speaker-aware audio gating , a training-free module that lets the audio drive only the faces of the active speakers. It first labels each face in the source video as speaking or silent with an off-the-shelf active-speaker detector. During denoising, it then transfers these labels to the corresponding faces in the new shot through the model’s attention and masks the audio conditioning on the silent faces, all in a single generation pass.

blocks.en: We evaluate our approach on two benchmarks. A paired-view benchmark uses two cameras that captured the same take from different viewpoints. An in-the-wild benchmark covers diverse crowded scenes, each pairing a wide-shot video with a close-up frame. On the paired views, our method lowers perceptual error by 59%, landmark error by 56%, and speech leakage by 97% relative to the strongest baseline, Wan 3.0 ( Wan Team, 2026 ) . On the in-the-wild clips, our model generalizes to crowded real-world scenes and is preferred over all baselines in 75% of user-study responses.

blocks.en: 2. Related Work
blocks.zh: 2. 相关工作

blocks.en: Computational cinematography automates the camera decisions of film grammar ( Arijon, 1976 ) . Such systems encode film idioms to place virtual cameras and cut between them, or plan shots from scene geometry, example clips, or on-screen constraints ( He et al., 1996 ; Christie et al., 2008 ; Galvane et al., 2018 ; Jiang et al., 2020 ; Courant et al., 2026 ) . Computational editing applies these idioms to footage and selects shots and cut points across several cameras or takes for dialogue scenes ( Berthouzoz et al., 2012 ; Arev et al., 2014 ; Leake et al., 2017 ) , narrated videos ( Truong et al., 2016 ) , and interviews ( Leake and Li, 2024 ) , and recent tools refine the timing of individual cuts ( Tran et al., 2026a ) . When only one camera is available, re-cinematography simulates the missing cameras by transforming the frames of the single recording ( Gleicher and Liu, 2008 ) . These methods typically move pan-tilt-zoom crop windows within a wide-angle or 360-degree recording and edit between the resulting virtual shots ( Gandhi et al., 2014 ; Moorthy et al., 2020 ; Truong and Agrawala, 2019 ) . EditIQ ( Girmaji et al., 2025 ) , for example, edits a static wide-angle dialogue recording by choosing among such virtual cameras based on the dialogue, the speakers, and visual saliency. A simulated camera, however, stays at the optical center of the real one. It can pan, tilt, and zoom, but it cannot move. A close-up therefore is a lower-resolution enlargement, and a shot from a new angle is out of reach. We instead synthesize the new views with generative models.
blocks.zh: 计算电影学将电影语法的相机决定自动化(Arijon,1976.). 此类系统编码了虚拟相机并剪接相机,或计划拍摄场景几何、实例片段或屏幕限制(He等,1996年;Christie等,2008年;Galvane等,2018年;Jiang等,2020年;Courant等,2026年)。 计算编辑将这些平面应用到镜头上,并选择拍摄和切分数个相机或用于对话场景的镜头(Berthouzoz等,2012年;Arev等,2014年;Leake等,2017年),叙事视频(Truong等,2016年)和访谈(Leake和Li,2024年),而最近的工具则完善了个人切分的时间(Tran等,2026a.). 当只有一款相机可用时,再焚相机通过转换单相录相机的帧来模拟缺失相机(Gleicher and Liu, 2008.). 这些方法通常会在广角或360度的收录和编辑范围内移动泛斜角作物窗口(Gandhi等人,2014年;Moorty等人,2020年;Truong和Agrawala,2019年)。 例如,EditIQ(Girmaji等,2025年)编辑一个静态的广角对话录音,在这种虚拟相机中根据对话、扬声器和视觉优势进行选择。 然而,模拟相机仍然停留在真相机的光学中心. 它能平地,倾斜,放大,但不能移动. 因此,特写是更低分辨率的扩展,从新角度的镜头是遥不可及的. 我们用基因模型来综合新观点。

blocks.en: Reconstruction-based methods fit radiance fields or Gaussians to a dynamic scene ( Mildenhall et al., 2020 ; Kerbl et al., 2023 ; Wu et al., 2024 ) , but reach high fidelity on faces and bodies only with many cameras ( Lombardi et al., 2019 ; Işık et al., 2023 ) and degrade quickly from a single static view. Multi-shot video generation methods synthesize several shots of one scene ( Kara et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2026 ; Meng et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026a ) , but they generate the scene from a text script alone and cannot re-film an existing take. Generative reshooting methods re-film an existing take following an input camera trajectory with a video diffusion model ( Bai et al., 2025b ; Zhang et al., 2025b ; Yu et al., 2025 ; Ren et al., 2025 ; Lin et al., 2026b ; Paliwal et al., 2026 ) . However, these methods condition on pixels alone, so they lack cues for lip motion when a face barely visible in the source fills the target view, for example when a profile wide shot is recut as a frontal close-up. The video prior then hallucinates articulation ( Tran et al., 2026b ) . We instead build on an audio-visual foundation model so that the original speech drives articulation.
blocks.zh: 基于重建的方法适合发光场或高斯人到动态场景(Mildenhall等,2020;Kerbl等,2023;Wu等,2024),但只用多相机在面部和身体上达到高度忠诚(Lombardi等,2019;Işık等,2023),从单一静态视角迅速降解. 多镜头视频生成方法合成了一幕的多场镜头(Kara等,2025;Wu等,2026;Meng等,2026;Wang等,2026a),但它们单独从文字剧本中生成了场景,无法再取回已存在的镜头. 使用视频传播模型的输入相机轨迹后,基因再射法重新拍摄现有相机(Bai等,2025b; 张等,2025b;于等,2025;任等,2025;林等,2026b;帕利瓦尔等,2026. 然而,这些方法仅以像素为条件,因此当一个在源头几乎看不到的面孔填充了目标视图时,它们就缺乏唇动的提示,例如当一个剖面宽镜头被重剪为前置特写. 之前的视频会发出幻觉(Tran等人,2026b.). 相反,我们以视听基础模式为基础,使最初的演讲能推动表达。

blocks.en:
Video editing models have developed from following text instructions ( Wu et al., 2023 ; Geyer et al., 2024 ; Cheng et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2026 ) to following visual references ( Wei et al., 2026 ; Lin et al., 2026a ) . Reference images can guide object insertion ( Lin et al., 2026a ; Chen et al., 2026a ; Liu et al., 2026 ) , keyframe edit propagation ( Ku et al., 2024 ; Ouyang et al., 2024 ; Polaczek et al., 2026b ) , and character animation and motion transfer ( Siarohin et al., 2019 ; Hu et al., 2024 ; Cheng et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025a ) . However, most of these editors are trained with references that share the same viewpoint as the source video. Given a frame from a completely different viewpoint, they tend to ignore it and fall back to the source view ( Burgert et al., 2026 ) . Without audio guidance, they also fail to generate correct lip sync. Recent omni-reference foundation models, such as MiniMax H3 ( MiniMax, 2026 ) and Wan 3.0 ( Wan Team, 2026 ) , take image, video, and audio references together. Applied to dialogue re-cinematography, they drive correct lip articulation from the audio but still show speech leakage, sometimes ignore the target frame, and hallucinate motion.
Multi-person talking-video models mitigate speech leakage by requiring a separate audio track for each person ( Kong et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2025 ) . In contrast, our model is optimized to transfer the original performance to the target view, and our speaker-aware audio gating suppresses speech leakage from a single mixed audio track.

视频编辑模式从遵循文本说明(Wu等,2023;Geyer等,2024;Cheng等,2024;Li等,2026)发展为遵循视觉参考(Wei等,2026;Lin等,2026a). 参考图像可以指导对象插入(Lin等,2026a; Chen等,2026a;Liu等,2026),键框编辑传播(Ku等,2024;Ouyang等,2024;Polaczek等,2026b),以及人物动画和运动转移(Siarohin等,2019;Hu等,2024;Cheng等,2025;Zhang等,2025a). 然而,这些编辑大多接受过与源视频相同观点的参考培训。 鉴于一个框架从完全不同的角度出发,他们倾向于忽略它,回到源的观点(Burgert等,2026.). 没有音频引导,它们也未能产生正确的唇同步. 近代的OMni参考基础模型,如MiniMax H3(MiniMax,2026年)和Wan 3.0(Wan Team,2026年),将图像,视频,音频参考一起取用. 应用到对话再焚化图中,它们从音频中驱动正确的口语表达,但仍显示语音漏出,有时忽略了目标框架,并产生幻觉运动.
多人对话-视频模型通过要求每个人有单独的音轨来缓解语音泄漏(Kong等,2025;Chen等,2025.). 相形之下,我们的模型被优化,将原始的性能转移到目标视图中,我们的扬声器-有意识的音频gating抑制了单一混合音频轨道的语音泄漏.

blocks.en: 3. Method
blocks.zh: 3个 方法

blocks.en: Given a source dialogue video V s V_{s} , its audio track A A , and a target frame I t I_{t} , we synthesize the requested target view while preserving the source performance (Figure 3 ). The target frame sets the framing (Section 3.1 ), and a pretrained audio-visual model, adapted with LoRA ( Hu et al., 2022 ) , takes the performance from the source video and the lip motion from the audio (Sections 3.2 and 3.3 ). At inference, speaker-aware gating keeps silent faces from being driven by another participant’s speech (Section 3.4 ).
blocks.zh: 鉴于一个源对话视频V s V_{s},它的音频音轨A A,以及目标帧 I t I_{t},我们综合了所要求的目标视图,同时保留了源性能(图3). 目标框架设定了框架(第3.1节),并与LORA(Hu等,2022年)相适应的经过预先训练的视听模型取自源视频的性能和从音频取自口腔动作(第3.2和3.3节)。 推论一下,有发言者意识的标语使沉默的面孔不被另一位参与者的演讲所驱使(第3.4节)。

blocks.en: 3.1. Cinematic Shot Control
blocks.zh: 3.1. 电影拍摄控制

blocks.en: The new shot is specified by providing a target frame I t I_{t} , which will be the first frame in the generated shot. To create I t I_{t} , an off-the-shelf image editing model ( Brooks et al., 2023 ; Wu et al., 2025 ; OpenAI, 2026 ; Google DeepMind, 2025 ; Team Seedream, 2025 ; Cao et al., 2025 ; Black Forest Labs, 2026 ) can edit the source video’s first frame following a shot prompt in common cinematic vocabulary ( Bowen, 2023 ) (Figure 2 ), such as “a medium close-up of the woman, at eye level.” Comparing several editing models (supplementary Table S1 ), we find that GPT-Image 2 performs best, so we use it to generate the target frames in Figure 5 . In our quantitative evaluation, we use the ground-truth target frame (Section 4.1 ).

blocks.en: 3.2. Audio-Visual In-Context Conditioning
blocks.zh: 3.2. 视听内容

blocks.en: We build on LTX-2.3 ( HaCohen et al., 2026 ) , a pretrained audio-visual diffusion transformer with separate video and audio streams (Figure 4 ). Video and audio VAEs encode the two modalities into latent tokens, and the diffusion model combines them through within-modality self-attention, text cross-attention, and bidirectional audio-video cross-attention. Trained jointly on audio and video, the model generates videos that synchronize lip motion with speech. Here we adapt the model to accept audio-visual conditioning with an in-context mechanism ( Huang et al., 2024 ; Ben-Yosef et al., 2026 ; Jiang et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2026b ; Polaczek et al., 2026b ) .
blocks.zh: 我们利用LTX-2.3(HaCohen等,2026年),这是一台经过预先训练的视听传播变压器,具有单独的视频和音频流(图4). 视频和音频VAE将两种模式编码为潜入的代号,而传播模式通过模式内自觉,文本交叉自觉,和双向音频-视频交叉自觉将两种模式结合起来. 该模型联合对音频和视频进行培训,生成视频,使口语动作与语音同步. 在这里,我们修改了该模型,以接受带有内文机制的视听调理(黄等,2024;本-约瑟夫等,2026;江等,2025;陈等,2026b;Polaczek等,2026b).

blocks.en: 3.4. Inference with Speaker-Aware Audio Gating
blocks.zh: 3.4. 对扬声器的推断

blocks.en: Pretrained audio-visual models produce accurate lip motion through audio-to-video cross-attention. This attention, however, updates every video token from the same audio tokens without knowing which face is speaking, so silent listeners also mouth the speaker’s words ( Polaczek et al., 2026a ) . To prevent this speech leakage, we add a training-free module at inference that suppresses audio-to-video updates on silent faces. We detect who speaks in the source and map the labels to the target view through the model’s attention (Figure 3 ).
blocks.zh: 预受训练的视听模型通过音频到视频的交叉注意产生准确的口腔运动. 因此沉默的听众也会说出发言者的话来(Polaczek等,2026a)。 为防止这段语音泄露,我们在推论中增加了一个无培训模块,压制了无声面的音频到视频更新. 我们通过模型的注意(图3),检测谁在源代码中说话,并将标签映射到目标视图上。

blocks.zh: 4.1. 评价设置

blocks.en: We first sample 100 cross-camera pairs from Replay ( Shapovalov et al., 2023 ) , using scenes held out from training, and crop the target video to cinematic framings such as close-ups and over-the-shoulder shots, keeping the source video wide. To increase benchmark scene diversity, we additionally collect 196 pairs of multi-camera footage from real productions on the internet. blocks.en: We measure appearance against the ground-truth target view with LPIPS ( Zhang et al., 2018 ) , MSE, and ArcFace ( Deng et al., 2019 ) identity similarity. blocks.en: Table 1 reports results on the paired-view benchmark, where each output is evaluated against the ground-truth target video. Our method outperforms both baselines on most metrics: the large gaps in LPIPS and MSE show a much closer match to the ground truth, and the facial, body, and dialogue metrics show that the captured performance is better preserved. blocks.en: 5. Conclusion, Limitations, and Future Work
blocks.zh: 5. 结论、限制和今后的工作

blocks.en: We presented a way to create multi-shot dialogue coverage from a single recording while preserving the original performance. Our starting point is that speech does not change with the camera. The original audio therefore provides a view-invariant cue for articulation, even when the speaker’s lips are barely visible in the source. Speaker-aware audio gating carries speaking activity across views and reduces speech leakage. On paired views recorded by real cameras, our method more accurately reproduces the target shot and better preserves facial and body motion and dialogue activity than the baselines. An editor can thus cut close-ups, over-the-shoulder views, and listener reactions against the original audio, all from a single take, and explore how to tell the story after the performance is captured.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了一种办法,在保留原始表现的同时,从单一录音中创建多镜头对话报道。 我们的出发点是,讲话不会随着相机而改变。 因此,即使发言人的嘴唇在源头几乎看不到,原始的音频也为表达提供了一种视而不见的提示。 扬声器的音响会传递各种观点的语音活动,减少语音泄漏。 在真实相机记录的对接视图上,我们的方法比基线更准确地复制了目标镜头,更好地保存了面部和身体运动和对话活动. 编辑因此可以剪去特写,过度肩部取景,并收听者对原声的反应,全部取自一首单曲,并探索表演被收录后如何讲述故事.

blocks.en: The quality of the new shot depends in part on the target frame and on correctly identifying who is speaking. Better target-frame generation could improve identity and pose consistency, and combining visual speaker detection with audio diarization could help resolve ambiguous cases. The video model also fills in details outside the source view with plausible estimates, so shots of real people should be made with their consent and disclosed as synthesized.
blocks.zh: 新镜头的质量部分取决于目标框和正确识别谁在说话. 更好的目标框架生成可以改善身份,形成一致性,将视觉扬声器检测与音频分化相结合有助于解决模棱两可的案件。 视频模型还以可信的估计填充了来源视图外的细节,因此真实人物的镜头应征得其同意后以合成方式被披露.

blocks.en: An intriguing direction is to explore whether other aspects of a performance can be described independently of the camera. A director-style description of gestures, gaze, and timing could provide a shared cue across shots, much as the original audio does for speech.
blocks.zh: 一个有趣的方向是探索一个性能的其他方面能否独立于相机进行描述. 对手势、目光和时间的导演式描述,可以提供共同的镜头提示,就像最初的语音一样。

blocks.en: We measure perceptual distance with LPIPS ( Zhang et al., 2018 ) and pixel error with the mean squared RGB error (MSE). Both are computed on the full frame against the ground-truth target view. Identity similarity is the cosine similarity between ArcFace ( Deng et al., 2019 ) embeddings of the generated and ground-truth faces.

blocks.en: Landmark distance (LMD) ( Chen et al., 2018 ) measures the mean distance between facial landmarks of the generated and reference faces, normalized by the reference face size. Facial expression error (AED) is the mean absolute difference between DECA ( Feng et al., 2021 ) expression coefficients. For gaze error, we compute the angle between head-relative gaze directions estimated with OpenFace 2 ( Baltrušaitis et al., 2018 ) .

blocks.en: We use TalkNet ( Tao et al., 2021 ) to obtain reference speaking labels and per-face scores on the output. Dialogue mAP is the mean of the average precision for speaking and for non-speaking activity. Speech leakage is the share of frames in which a face that is silent in the source speaks in the target output. blocks.en: A model can keep identity similarity high by copying the source video instead of moving to the target view. blocks.en: B.3. Baseline Implementation
blocks.zh: B.3. 基线执行情况

blocks.en:
Every baseline receives the source video and the target frame of each clip, the source audio when it accepts audio, and a clip-independent text prompt. We run the open-source MiniMax H3 ( MiniMax, 2026 ) with its default settings ( 12 12 denoising steps), 4 4 -second outputs, and a fixed seed, and the Wan 3.0 ( Wan Team, 2026 ) API at 720 720 p with prompt expansion enabled.
The camera-controlled models GEN3C ( Ren et al., 2025 ) and Vista4D ( Lin et al., 2026b ) take a target camera pose instead of the target frame. We estimate the pose by reconstructing the source video with π 3 \pi^{3} ( Wang et al., 2026b ) and registering the target frame to it with RoMa v2 ( Edstedt et al., 2026 ) matches and PnP. Neither takes audio, so the source audio is attached to their outputs. The reference-guided video editors VINO ( Chen et al., 2026a ) and Bernini-R ( Liu et al., 2026 ) take the source video and the target frame but no audio.
blocks.zh:
每个基线都接收每个片段的源视频和目标帧,接受音频时的源音频,以及一个剪辑独立的文本提示. 我们运行开源的MiniMax H3(MiniMax,2026年),其默认设置(12个12个去诺音阶),4个4秒输出,以及一个固定种子,而Wan 3.0(Wan Team,2026年) API则以720 720 p的速度快速扩展.

blocks.zh: D.1. 网上定性比较

blocks.en: Figure S3 compares our method with the baselines, camera-controlled models, and reference-guided video editors on two in-the-wild clips. The camera-controlled models and the reference-guided video editors struggle with the large change of viewpoint. GEN3C breaks down into artifacts, and Vista4D, VINO, and Bernini-R stay at the wide source framing. The reference-guided video generation models H3 ( MiniMax, 2026 ) and Wan 3.0 ( Wan Team, 2026 ) reach the requested close-up and move the lips with the speech. However, they generate their own gestures and expressions instead of following the source performance, and they can make silent listeners mouth the speaker’s words.

blocks.en: D.2. End-to-End Qualitative Comparison
blocks.zh: D.2. 端对端定性比较

blocks.en:
Figure S4 compares MiniMax H3, Wan 3.0, and our method end to end on in-the-wild clips, where the new shot is requested with a shot prompt instead of a target frame. Our pipeline first generates the target frame I t I_{t} from the prompt with GPT-Image 2 (Section 3.1 ), and H3 and Wan 3.0 receive the source video, the audio, and the shot prompt. The examples show three baseline failure modes.
First, speech is attributed to the wrong face: both baselines animate the listener’s mouth in the two left examples, as does Wan 3.0 in the lower-right. In the upper-right two-shot, H3 silences the right-hand man while he speaks, and Wan 3.0 keeps him speaking after he falls silent.
Second, the generated motion deviates from the captured performance: both baselines produce hand gestures that do not match the source in the two left examples and, in the lower-left, direct the subject’s gaze toward the opposite participant.
Third, framing and appearance drift: H3 pulls the wrong participant into the upper-right two-shot and leaves ghosted outlines of glasses and hands in the lower-right.
